item.title: Qatar Tourism Reports Steady Visitor Growth and sets the stage for a Packed Q4 Line-Up
item.description: Qatar Tourism announced performance results for the first three quarters of 2025, confirming sustained growth in arrivals and accommodation demand as the country prepares for a full schedule of events in the final quarter and early 2026.International visitors reached over 3.5 million by the end of September, recording a 2.2 percent increase compared with the same period in 2024. item.title: From Doha to Bangkok: Johann Sebastien Garcia Skates for the Philippines on the SEA Games Stage
item.description: At just a young age, Johann Sebastien Garcia has already traveled a remarkable journey, one defined by discipline, faith, leadership, and an unrelenting love for ice hockey. item.title: Batang PBA Middle East 2026: Biggest Filipino Youth Basketball Event in the Gulf Tips Off in Qatar
item.description: The Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) is set to make history as it brings its official youth league to the Middle East for the first time.Batang PBA Middle East 2026, the largest Filipino youth basketball event in the region, will tip off in Doha, Qatar from February 6 to 8, featuring over 30 teams from 6 GCC countries—Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, the UAE, Oman, and Kuwait.This landmark 3-day tournament will turn Qatar into a hub for youth basketball, cultural pride, and elite competition
